title: 한국관광공사법 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:9:2:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9-2 (Scope of Public Organizations)
"Institutions prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 12 (3) of the Act means the following:
1. Local government-directly operated enterprises under Article 5 of the Local Public Enterprises Act, local public corporations under Article 49 of the same Act, and local public agencies under Article 76 of the same Act;
2. Institutions invested in or contributed to by local governments designated by the Minister of the Interior and Safety pursuant to Article 5 of the Act on the Operation of Local Government-Invested or -Funded Institutions.
